nom: DERMA E Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Scrub with Glycolic Acid

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the product does not dry out her skin and works well nightly.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers with sensitive/acne-prone skin report the scrub is gentle and does not trigger breakouts.
segments.dry: One reviewer mentions using it on a partner's flaky, dry post-acne-treatment skin with softening results.
segments.mature: Several reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles report smoother, softer, more youthful-looking skin, though skin type is not always specified.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visible improvement in fine lines and wrinkles with regular use, describing softer, smoother skin; no reviewer disputes this effect specifically.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive skin reports it helps soften and reduce blemishes without irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says the product does not effectively remove dead skin near the lips, chin, or nose, calling it ineffective for polishing in those areas.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with oily skin says it does not dry out her skin, and another notes it helps dry, flaky skin feel softer; no reports of over-drying were found.
concerns.barrier: One sensitive-skin reviewer notes most cleansers cause her acne but this one does not, suggesting it is non-irritating for reactive skin.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels smooth and soft after use
Tube clogs and hard to dispense
Granules stick to eyelashes on rinsing
Good value for long-term repeat use

extraits.texte: Ultimately my issue with this product is the texture. The "grit" in it is too chunky but there is also not enough of it in the cream base to feel like a scrub. I felt like it barely did anything. It also congealed very easily and kept clogging the tube. I got tired of constantly having to clean the opening to get product out and ended up throwing out an almost full bottle. Waste of money. I cannot speak to how well the product worked for improving my skin since I hardly used any of it.
This product does not remove areas of dead skin cells near lips, chin, or nose well. I felt it was not effective in polishing off skin after a mask or treatment.

Well this was my first time using this product and I LOVE IT !!!! I have fine lines on my forehead and I hate them & using this product has helped so much . I wet my face first then add the product to my face & neck. I do leave it on for a few then wash off with warm water. This product leaves my face so soft and smooth . I then use a face cream so my skin looks flawless .

extraits.titre: My complexion has never been better
extraits.texte: I use this nightly amd sometimes in am. My skin is on the oily side so it doesn't make my skin dry. I have sensitive skin and most cleansers will cause acne. I love all these natural Derme products

I've been using this for several years. I feel like it does a good job exfoliating my skin. It's not overly abrasive. After rinsing, my face feels clean and smooth. Some viewers complain about the smell. It's not highly fragranced, which to me is a good thing.

I'm 24, but I use this product to exfoliate my acne-prone, sensitive skin. Not only is it gentle, it really does help soften and reduce blemishes and fine lines. My BF uses it to help with his flaky, dry skin (post acne treatment). This stuff rocks.

extraits.titre: Smells like Bathroom Cleaner and Doesn't Scrub.
extraits.texte: I used this product once in the shower. Not trying to spend too much, I bought this face wash- I used Derma E scar gel and it works wonders, so thought this would too. This ended up smelling like legitimate bathroom cleaner. I used it once- the scrub is so sparse that it's like random beads where scattered across my face. Didn't give me the opportunity to scrub at all.
